children: Tyler Technologies entered a Rule 10b5-1 plan to repurchase up to $260.0 million of common stock beginning Sept. 16, 2026.
Plan authorizes up to $260.0 million in repurchases under a Rule 10b5-1 agreement running Sept. 16–Oct. 29, 2026.
As of Sept. 15, 2026, the board has remaining repurchase authorization of up to $1.416 billion.
Repurchases may be funded from cash balances and borrowings under the company credit facility.
The Plan complies with Rule 10b5-1 and Tyler’s insider trading policy to allow prearranged trades.
